sb_url.description: Base URL for the Debian Bug Tracking System

sb_default_method.description: Default search method: 'src' (source package), 'pkg' (binary package), or 'bug' (bug number)

sb_bug_include_num.description: Whether to include the bug number in the URL when searching by bug number

sb_extra_methods.description: List of additional search methods for custom extensions; each item defines a method name, its URL template, and description. Example: {"name": "release", "url": "https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/pkgreport.cgi?archive=0&distro=stable&pkg={{query}}", "desc": "Search by release"}
